title: The common room
teaches: Saying and doing in one line
blurb: An inn full of travellers and news. Ask, listen, lend a hand, and see who remembers you.
after: Talk is how most things happen here. People remember what you said and did, pass it on, and answer as themselves.
refines: Do players find Say and Do in one line? Do group answers read well? Do the leads people give land in the journal?
goal: Find out how a stranger gets into the city

things.name: pewter tankard
things.description: Ivo's own dented pewter tankard, still wet: he knocked it off the table.

steps.title: A common room
cards: …signal. The Ford Inn's common room: travellers, ale, and news. Most of what you'll do here is talk.
People here answer as themselves: what they know, what they want, what they think of you.

steps.title: The innkeeper
cards: That's Doran behind the bar. Go and say good evening.
steps.done: Anyone near can hear what you say, and they remember it.

steps.title: Asking
cards: People know things. Ask Doran about the city: how a stranger gets in. Ask in your own words.

suggest.text: What's the news from the city? Can a stranger get in?

on_done.lead: The city lets strangers in only if someone will speak for them.
on_done.said: Captain lets you in only if someone'll speak for you.

steps.done: What people tell you goes in your journal, under who told you.
help: Type a question with the city or the gate in it.

playtest.say: What's the news from the city? Can a stranger get in?

steps.title: Say and do

on_start.text: Oi, you. Pass me my tankard, would you? Knocked it off and my back's gone.

cards: Ivo the carter has knocked his tankard off the table. Pick it up.
Then hand it to him and say something, in one line: {Tab} switches between SAY (blue) and DO (red), even halfway through. Like this:

suggest.text: “You dropped this.” hand Ivo the pewter tankard

steps.task: Pick up the tankard and hand it to Ivo with a word
steps.done: One line, both at once: what you say in blue, what you do in red.
help: Pick up the tankard, walk to Ivo, press {T}, type words in quotes then what you do.
Or drag the tankard onto Ivo.

playtest.do: “You dropped this.” hand Ivo the pewter tankard

steps.title: A group
cards: Wynn the pilgrim has been listening. Talk to her: when people are near each other, more than one may answer, and they talk among themselves.

on_done.lead: Ada at the water mill pays fairly for help.
on_done.said: Ada at the mill pays fair, and she's always short a pair of hands.

steps.done: Conversations here are among everyone near, not one at a time.

steps.title: Walking away
cards: You can leave a conversation whenever you like: press {Esc}, or just walk off. Then warm yourself by the fire.
steps.task: Walk away, then go and stand by the fire
steps.done: Walking off ends a friendly talk. Walking off from an angry guard is another matter.
help: Press {Esc}, then walk to the fireplace at the top right.

steps.title: People
cards: Press {J} and open People: everyone you've met, how each stands toward you, and every word between you.
steps.task: Press J and look at People
steps.done: Neutral, Friendly, Wary: how people stand toward you changes with what you do, and they tell each other.

reactions.killed: …You killed someone. That can't be undone. Rewind from the menu if that isn't what you meant.
reactions.arrested: They've taken you away. Rewind from the menu to try again.
reactions.dead: You died. Rewind to the last calm moment and try something else.
